personal.name: Darshan Prabhakar
personal.summary: I am a recent engineering graduate with practical experience in Java backend development through apprenticeship and fellowship programs. Skilled in Spring Boot, RESTful APIs, and MySQL database design, I also bring versatility as a full-stack developer with React and modern web technologies. I enjoy creating solutions that are both functional and meaningful, driven by curiosity and a passion for continuous learning.

experience.title: Apprentice Software Developer
bullets: Developed and maintained enterprise Java web applications using Servlets, JSP, and JDBC following MVC architecture in an Agile environment.
Implemented secure backend modules for user authentication and product management, emphasizing data retrieval efficiency.
Collaborated with cross-functional teams to resolve UI defects and optimize database queries, resulting in improved page load performance.
Participated in code reviews and sprint planning sessions, contributing to iterative feature development and team knowledge sharing.

experience.title: Software Development Fellow
bullets: Developed TalentBridge, a skill-based campus placement platform using Spring Boot, Spring MVC, and MySQL.
Designed and implemented RESTful API endpoints using Spring REST Controllers for user authentication, profile management, and skill assessment functionality.
Created a responsive web interface using JSP, Thymeleaf templates, and Bootstrap, adhering to mobile-first design principles and accessibility standards.
Leveraged Spring Data JPA and Hibernate ORM for efficient database operations and data persistence layer implementation.

education.degree: Bachelor of Engineering in Information Science and Engineering

projects.title: PetHub — E-commerce Web Application
projects.description: Developed a full-stack e-commerce web application for pet product inventory and order management with complete end-to-end functionality. Built a RESTful backend and a React.js frontend with secure user authentication.

projects.title: Cattle Disease Pattern Prediction System
projects.description: Architected a Spring Boot application to analyze historical cattle health records using rule-based classification algorithms. Developed comprehensive RESTful APIs and implemented a data access layer using Spring Data JPA.
